start.pose: Standing upright, feet about shoulder width, neutral spine, weight balanced through tripod feet.

execution.pose: Hips back and down, knees tracking with toes, heels grounded, neutral spine and controlled torso.

return.pose: Controlled ascent to upright stance with knees and hips extending together.

start.pose: High plank, hands under/slightly wider than shoulders, head-pelvis-heels aligned.

execution.pose: Chest lowered under control, elbows in a natural angle, rigid trunk and neutral neck.

return.pose: Press floor away and return to high plank without hip sag or pike.

local:lunge.name: Forward Lunge
local:lunge.camera: 3/4 side view showing both feet and knee alignment

start.pose: Tall standing posture, pelvis neutral, feet hip width.

execution.pose: Forward split stance lowered vertically; front knee tracks over foot, rear knee approaches floor, torso controlled.

return.pose: Push through front foot and return under control to balanced standing.

start.pose: Forearms supported, elbows under shoulders, toes grounded, neutral head-to-heel line.

execution.pose: Maintain anti-extension brace: ribs controlled, pelvis neutral, glutes active, no lumbar sag.

return.pose: Maintain the same stable plank position with controlled breathing; isometric exercise has no artificial limb motion.

reformer:r1:footwork.name: Reformer Footwork / Leg Press
reformer:r1:footwork.camera: strict side profile showing entire Reformer and carriage travel

start.pose: Supine on carriage, head supported, shoulders at rests, neutral pelvis, feet symmetrical on footbar, knees flexed.

execution.pose: Press carriage away by extending both legs together while pelvis and torso remain stable; knees not aggressively locked.

return.pose: Bend knees under spring control as carriage returns toward footbar while maintaining alignment and foot contact.
